Class TriMeshPool

Namespace
ShapeEngine.ShapeClipper
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Provides a simple reusable pool of TriMesh instances to reduce allocations during repeated triangulation work.

Remarks

Rented meshes are cleared before being returned to the caller, and returned meshes are cleared again before being stored in the pool. This type is intended for manual reuse patterns and does not perform thread synchronization.

startCapacity int
